title: A Flying Reptile as Tall as a Giraffe Had 34-Foot Wings

scenes.text: A flying animal as tall as a giraffe once ruled the sky.
Quetzalcoatlus had a wingspan of about thirty-four feet.
That is about as wide as a small airplane.
Yet by one estimate, it weighed only about one hundred fifty-five pounds.
Scientists think it ran down a slope to take off.
It rose up on its back legs, unfolded its wings and flapped.
It lived about sixty-seven million years ago. Wings like a plane, height of a giraffe.

description:
A flying animal as tall as a giraffe once ruled the sky.
Quetzalcoatlus, a pterosaur, had wings about 34 feet across and, by one estimate, weighed only about 155 pounds.
Would you have flown on its back?
first_comment: Bonus: other scientists estimate it was much heavier. How big do you think it really was?
